name: Pokecut Admin
summary: Admin dashboard demo for the Pokecut AI photo-editing platform: users, payments, tool usage, moderation and system health.
description: Multi-page static admin dashboard with overview, user, payment, tool, report, analytics and access pages. Widgets include KPI stat cards, generation-trend and hourly-activity charts, a content-moderation queue, tool failure logs and system-health metrics.
contains: pages: dashboard, user overview, payments, tools, reports, analytics, access
KPI cards: total users, live engaging, new signups, avg session
charts: generation trend (24h), top tools used, hourly activity, daily user growth
content moderation queue with statuses (NSFW, safe for work, explicit imagery)
system health: AI model status, avg render time, GPU load
user directory columns: agent name, plan, generations, last active, tools used
